items.title: Terra's surprise strength is computer use
items.summary: Models: On Agent's Last Exam, Terra scored slightly above every other OpenAI model, Astra included. It ran at about half Sol's cost, a tenth of Astra's, and three times faster than both. It came close to Opus 5.5's score at one-ninth the price. On most other benchmarks, including agentic coding, it lands slightly below Sol. The early consensus: probably not for writing code, probably yes for computer use.
